description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [MAG and RES +30% (25s)], [Attach Lightning], [Awoken Lightning], [Damage Cap +10000], [Lightning Instant Cast] and [Fierce Twinbolt] to the user

description.name: Attach Lightning
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Lightning damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Lightning resistance +20%

description.name: Awoken Lightning
description.text: Lightning abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Lightning abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Lightning Instant Cast
description.text: Instant cast speed for Lightning attacks

description.name: Fierce Twinbolt
description.text: Casts Fierce Twinbolt twice when Awoken Lightning is removed, removed if the character hasn't Awoken Lightning
